> show running-config
! Command: show running-config at line 1
! device: NEW1 (cEOSLab, EOS-4.36.2F-49692632.4362F.1 (engineering build))
!
no aaa root
!
!
no service interface inactive port-id allocation disabled
!
service routing protocols model multi-agent
!
hostname NEW1
!
spanning-tree mode mstp
!
system l1
   unsupported speed action error
   unsupported error-correction action error
!
aaa authorization exec default local
!
interface Ethernet1
   description NMAS bootstrap uplink ZTP-000001
   no switchport
   ip address 10.254.60.10/24
   ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
!
interface Ethernet2
   no switchport
   ip address 10.254.64.1/24
   ip helper-address 10.254.61.2
   ip access-group NMAS-ISO-DEV-000003-V4 in
   ip access-group NMAS-ISO-DEV-000003-V4-OUT out
   ipv6 access-group NMAS-ISO-DEV-000003-V6 in
   ipv6 access-group NMAS-ISO-DEV-000003-V6-OUT out
   ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
!
interface Loopback0
   ip address 10.254.255.11/32
   ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
!
ipv6 access-list NMAS-ISO-DEV-000003-V6
   counters per-entry
   10 permit icmpv6 fe80::/10 any
   1000 deny ipv6 any any
!
ipv6 access-list NMAS-ISO-DEV-000003-V6-OUT
   counters per-entry
   1000 deny ipv6 any any
!
ip access-list NMAS-BOOTSTRAP-MGMT
   10 permit tcp host 10.254.61.2 any eq ssh
!
ip access-list NMAS-ISO-DEV-000003-V4
   counters per-entry
   10 permit udp any eq bootpc any eq bootps
   20 permit tcp 10.254.64.0/24 host 10.254.61.2 eq 8080
   30 permit tcp 10.254.64.0/24 eq ssh host 10.254.61.2
   1000 deny ip any any
!
ip access-list NMAS-ISO-DEV-000003-V4-OUT
   counters per-entry
   10 permit tcp host 10.254.61.2 eq 8080 10.254.64.0/24
   20 permit tcp host 10.254.61.2 10.254.64.0/24 eq ssh
   1000 deny ip any any
!
ip routing
!
ip route 10.254.61.0/30 10.254.60.1
!
router ospf 1
   router-id 10.254.255.11
   passive-interface Ethernet2
   passive-interface Loopback0
   max-lsa 12000
!
management ssh
   ip access-group NMAS-BOOTSTRAP-MGMT in
!
end
